transcript.message: I can confirm commercial and residential access are segregated. Within the residential areas, residents share the tower lift lobby and corridors—private corridors aren’t shown. Each block has 4 passenger lifts plus a Bomba lift, though that can’t guarantee peak-hour wait times.
